notes.title: Roll into the Crystal Corridors today in this brand new Game Dev Arcade update!
notes.content:
The time is here! A new mini game, 💎Crystal Corridors💎, has just been added to Game Dev Arcade as we move to v0.3.0.

In Crystal Corridors, you play as a spherical delivery boy named Marvin from the planet Crystalopolis. On a delivery, your ship has crash landed on an unknown planet. What horrors lay beneath the fog?? ☠️

Your task is to collect all of the fallen spaceship crystals in each level to regain some of your powers and warp to new areas of the Corridors, all in the hope that you can power your ship back up to escape.

New abilities unlock as you progress through the game, and reaching each new level requires you to complete the previous level under the set Par Time. Finish all the levels fast enough to unlock a speedy new mode! 🏁

This platformer was a blast to make, and my first attempt at some real level design. I can't wait for everyone to try it out! Post your best times and compete with the rest of the community.

See you in the Arcade! 🕹️
❤️Bulwark Creative

notes.title: Monstrous Maze has arrived in Game Dev Arcade v0.2!!
notes.content:
A new game has just arrived for 🎃 Halloween 🎃 in Game Dev Arcade v0.2!!

In Monstrous Maze, you'll quickly learn that you're the main course for tonight's dinner hosted in the Ghoul's basement. Maneuver your way through the maze to find the portal that'll take you home, or be prepared for a very unpleasant evening. 

The more times you escape the Ghoul's maze, the better you will get at evading them! You can achieve up to 15 levels by gaining experience at the end of each cleared maze. Each level will raise 1 of 3 stats:

Stamina 🏃‍♂️

Stamina quickly depletes as you run, this stat will increase the maximum amount of Stamina you can have.

Stamina Regeneration 💤

Stamina Regeneration is how much Stamina you will gain each second when not Sprinting (there's a short delay before it begins to charge). This stat gives you more Stamina back per second.

Teleport Charges 🪄

Teleporting let's you slip past a Ghoul that is in your way. When this stat is increased, you'll get another maximum Teleport Charge to use.
You can also unlock new Difficulties that increase the size of the maze, as well as increase the amount of Ghouls that are chasing you down. Each new difficulty requires you to clear the previous difficulty 5 times before you can attempt it. You'll get much more experience for clearing harder difficulties!

Start the Halloween week off right by spending some precious time with the Ghouls. This game was a blast to make, and I'm excited to go back and continue working on Crystal Corridors for v0.3.

See you in the Arcade! 🕹️
❤️ Bulwark Creative

notes.title: GDA Updated to v0.1.6
notes.content:
v0.1.5 introduced a couple bugs that I wanted to squish in Mars Madness before I launch the next minigame since that's still about a month away. 

Also, I'm improving some level design skills and I wanted to implement a cool new trick I learned for materials - displacement. The ground in MM should be a little more realistic and have a few topography changes around the arena. 

GDA:

 Added a title screen when launching the game


MM:

 Changed the ground material and added displacement

Arena ground topography is slightly more variable



BUG FIXES:

 Modified some collision settings so aiming is smoother

 Pointer was essentially enabled to collide with the alien's hit box causing some jumping around when continuously aiming at it.

 Save data should now be properly loading at the beginning of each round

notes.title: Game Dev Arcade Updated to v0.1.5!!
notes.content:
Hey all! Game Dev Arcade is now updated to v.0.1.5! This update focuses on adding some new features to "Mars Madness". Read below for a list of patch notes! 

I also made a video highlighting the biggest changes:
[previewyoutube=Wu57_NXYAdo;full][/previewyoutube]

NEW FEATURES:
Steam Integration

 You can now view the Steam Community tab while in game (default Shift+Tab)
 30 Steam Achievements have been added! Progress through all the Unlock Tiers in Mars Madness to collect them all! 

BOSSES

 Every 5 waves, a boss will spawn along with the normal aliens!
 Each increment of 5 adds 1 more boss spawn
 They have much more health and deal a lot of damage. Be careful around them!

Unlock Tier Changes

 Unlocks are now based off of your TOTAL stats (it used to be the furthest you got on a single run).
 Requirements have been bumped up to account for this

Sprinting Rework

 Sprinting has an added benefit - it gives phasing!
 This means you can pass through enemies while you are Sprinting
 No more getting trapped in corners by aliens!

Detailed list of patch notes further below.
[hr][/hr] 
Thank you so much for playing! This is my first game dev project, and the first game I've shipped. I'm excited to continue to improve it by adding more games that will come out (hopefully) more polished now that I'm getting a lot more experience developing.

Next patch will be v.0.2.0 where I will introduce the second game to the collection: Crystal Corridors!
If you'd like a sneak peak for how that game was made (in it's current beta state) you can watch the YouTube playlist here:  Crystal Corridors YouTube Playlist.
It will be receiving a facelift and more levels before making its way to GDA ːsteamhappyː

If you'd like to keep up to date with Game Dev Arcade's development you can do so by checking the Roadmap on Trello or via Bulwark Creative's Twitter page.

If you'd like to download the Unreal Engine project files, you can do so by visiting my Google Drive page.
[hr][/hr] 
Patch Notes:

Game Dev Arcade (Meta) Changes:

 Changed Supported OS to Windows 64bit only (previously Windows)
 Change icon image of executable
 Cleaned up Social Media buttons (removed Discord, YouTube, and GDTV)
 Added Steam API support - can now access steam overlay with Shift+Tab
 Added more comments in the Unreal Engine project files (available in Google Drive)
 Added intro splash screen
 Added animation to loading text

Mars Madness Changes:

 Added bosses!! Every 5 waves, at least one big alien spider will spawn. They are chunky, but will go down if pumped with enough lead.
 Added achievements! 30 total, one for each new tier you unlock.
 Achievements for tiers you've already unlocked will unlock on start up.
 Added more spawn points (still denser in middle)
 Sprinting now gives you "phasing" - you can pass through enemies while it's active
 Unlocks are now based on "total" stats: waves completed, kills, and time survived (used to be based on "best" stats).
 Unlock requirements have been adjusted higher now that they can be achieved through multiple games.
 Adjusted bonus stat values for kill unlock tier
 Aliens may take more or less amounts of shots to kill as you progress, but time to kill will go down as your tier gets higher.
 Moved alien health to Survive tiers, and alien damage to kill tiers.
 Added autosave - saves every 60sec. 
 Added stat tooltips. Hover over a stat in the pause screen to get an explanation of what the value means.
 Converted displayed speed value from cm/s to m/s.
 Added a wave complete screen and sound effect
 Adjusted time between waves from 2sec to 10sec (can skip by pressing Q)
 You now get Survive Tier x 25 hp on health pickup
 Health Pickups now spawn every 30sec during a wave, and 1 spawns on wave completion
 You now get your bonus health added to your current health if your survive tier upgrades mid game
 Added a few small rocks around the map to spice it up
 BUG FIX -  survive timer now pauses when dead
 BUG FIX -  sprint effect now doesn't overwrite death animation if you die while sprinting


Happy Alien Hunting ːsteammockingː

-Bulwark Creative
